title: Chapter 755 Find Lin Chengzhen; Go!
content:
Chapter 755 Find Lin Chengzhen; Go!

Chapter 755  Find Lin Chengzhen; Go!

Lin Fan looked around.

The withered trees and writhing snakes were extremely desolate and decaying.

Then, he began to use soul communication with Lin Chengzhen.

"True!"

After a long while, a hoarse reply came.

"Dad?"

When Lin Fan heard his voice, he heaved a sigh of relief.

Then, his heart ached again.

What had his son experienced to make him sound so tired? There was even a hint of despair in his voice.

"Cheng Zhen, where are you now?" Lin Fan asked.

"I... I'm in the dark universe." Lin Chengzhen said.

"Coordinates." Lin Fan asked again.

"What? Coordinates…It was 912365, 892, 101."Lin Chengzhen said.

"Alright, I'll come and find you. Don't worry, I'll take care of everything."After Lin Fan finished speaking, he ended the soul communication.

In the past, Lin Fan would have been worried.

Now, he had nothing to fear.

Because even if Lin Chengzhen was surrounded by Sacred Lords, he was confident that he could take him away safely.

....

At this moment, in a quiet courtyard.

Lin Chengzhen's hair was disheveled as he lay on the table.

At this moment, in a quiet courtyard.

Lin Chengzhen's hair was disheveled as he lay on the table.

"Cheng Zhen, there are plenty of fish in the sea," Li Hao said. Don't be obsessed anymore. I know a pair of twins. They are pure, cute, and absolutely beautiful. The older sister is lively, and the younger sister is gentle. They are very beautiful. Why don't I bring it over for you to take a look?"

"Whoosh!"

Lin Chengzhen suddenly stood up.

"Cheng Zhen, what's wrong?" Li Hao asked. Have you thought it through? Haha! My persuasion finally worked!"

"My dad is coming," Lin Chengzhen said."

"Your dad?" Li Hao was stunned for a moment." Are you dreaming? This is the dark universe, and it's unknown how far away from Earth. Uncle's cultivation is very high, but it's also very difficult to travel such a long distance…"

"Of course, it's not impossible." If they didn't get lost, they should be able to get here in tens of thousands of years."

"Dad!" Lin Chengzhen shouted."

"Hey!" Li Hao replied reflexively.

Behind him, a deep voice sounded,""Little fellow, are you trying to replace me?"

Li Hao's heart tightened.

Because he didn't know that someone was behind him.

If the other party had evil intentions, wouldn't his head fall to the ground?

This was definitely a very dangerous thing.

Li Hao hurriedly turned around and jumped back several meters to maintain a safe distance.

However, Lin Fan didn't really care too much about this.

He immediately turned his gaze to Lin Chengzhen.

At this moment, Lin Chengzhen's appearance was unkempt, and his face was sickly. There were many wounds on his body, especially the wound on his abdomen. It hurt his foundation, not only making it impossible for him to circulate his energy, but also causing him to constantly endure great pain.

Lin Cheng didn't seem to be in any pain.

Lin Fan's face turned ugly.

Who was it that dared to injure Cheng Zhen to such an extent?

He raised his hand and waved. The surging light of life surged into Lin Cheng Zhen's body like spring water.

Lin Chengzhen felt his body warm up.

Then, the injuries on his body healed at a speed visible to the naked eye.

After a dozen breaths, he had completely returned to his original state, and his entire person became extremely relaxed.

"Thank you, Dad," Lin Chengzhen said in surprise."

Lin Fan waved his hand and said," Why are you being so polite with me?"

"Tell me, how did you get your injuries?" Especially the one in the abdomen."

When Lin Chengzhen heard this, he seemed to have thought of something, and his expression became dejected again.

Lin Fan noticed this as well and frowned.

Li Hao, who was at the side, had his mouth wide open from Lin Fan's actions.

At this moment, he finally came back to his senses.

"Uncle Lin, aren't you too amazing?"

"Uncle Lin, is this the legendary Light of Life? He had actually completely cured Cheng Cheng in such a short period of time. It was too magical!"

"Uncle Lin, can you treat me too? Here... This place…Everyone here is injured."

Li Hao kept pointing at the wounds on his body and even pulled his pants.

Lin Fan knew that Li Hao was a good friend of Lin Chengzhen. Hence, he casually threw out a ray of light.

"Whoosh!"

The next moment, Li Hao jumped up.

"Alright, everything's fine! He's too powerful!"

When he turned his head, he happened to see Lin Chengzhen, who was still in a daze. He couldn't help but fall silent.

"Uncle Lin, please persuade Cheng Zhen too. Don't let him hang himself on a tree.""

"What do you mean?" Lin Fan asked.

Hence, Li Hao roughly explained what had happened.

So...

Although Ke Xin had told Lin Chengzhen not to look for him.

However, Lin Chengzhen still couldn't stop missing her and spared no effort to find her.

Heaven did not disappoint those who put in the effort.

Lin Chengzhen finally knew where Kexin came from.

She was the youngest daughter of the Lord of the Dashi Dynasty, Klett, one of the four dynasties of the Dark Universe.

After learning about his background, Lin Chengzhen rushed to the Dashi Dynasty as fast as he could.

This action made Klett angry.

He claimed that he was not worthy!

Prince Ji Wei had even severely injured Lin Cheng Zhen with a single finger.

If it wasn't for Kexin's death, Lin Chengzhen might have already died.

When Lin Fan heard this, his face turned extremely ugly. He said in a deep voice,""There is no woman in this world that my son is not worthy of!"

"Cheng Zhen, I'll go to the Great Dynasty with you!"

In fact, after Lin Chengzhen's injuries had completely recovered, he had really thought of looking for Kexin again.

However, when he heard Lin Fan's words, he started to hesitate.

It didn't matter if he was injured, humiliated, or even killed.

However, he did not want to implicate his father.

Lin Fan said," A man, why are you being so wishy-washy?" What, you don't like that Kexin anymore?"

"No, I like her!" Lin Chengzhen said," But…"

"As long as you like it!" Lin Fan said," Let's go!"

"Uncle Lin, can you bring me along?" Li Hao asked."

Li Hao and Lin Cheng were really good brothers who had gone through life and death together.

Back then, if he knew that Lin Cheng had really gone to the Dashi Dynasty to find his lover…

He must have followed them.

All these years, Li Hao had been in a terrible mood when he saw Lin Cheng Zhen's dejected appearance.

He wanted to help his good brother.

Even if the helper might be injured or even die.

Lin Fan could tell that Li Hao was serious. He nodded and said,""Do you know the way?"

"I know him!" Li Hao said.

"Alright, show me the way."

As soon as he finished speaking, Lin Fan, Lin Cheng Zhen, and Li Hao disappeared from where they were.
